name: Tremor
overview: Tremor is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include involuntary muscle contraction. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: In routine practice, a tremor is an involuntary, somewhat rhythmic muscle contraction and relaxation involving oscillations or twitching movements of one or more body parts.
Health professionals note that it is the most common of all involuntary movements and can affect the hands, arms, eyes, face, head, vocal folds, trunk, and legs.
In routine practice, most tremors occur in the hands.
In routine practice, in some people, a tremor is a symptom of another neurological disorder.
